about.title: About
about.bio: Electrical and Computer Engineer with {years}+ years of experience across quality engineering, automation, robotics, and software development, working with clients across multiple industries.
about.philosophyText: ISTQB Certified (6x), with a background in Electrical and Computer Engineering with a Master's in Automation and Robotics. I bring a broad, analytical approach to solving technical problems from test strategy and automation to workload modelling and custom software collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-quality systems.

quality.name: Quality Engineering
quality.description: Test strategy, automation, and quality processes that ensure reliable, scalable software delivery, with a focus on API testing, CI/CD, and GenAI-assisted workflows.

automation.name: Electrical Engineering for Automation & Robotics
automation.description: Design and development of automation and robotics systems, drawing on a background in Electrical and Computer Engineering with a Master's in Automation and Robotics.

consulting.name: Consulting for Doctors
consulting.description: Consulting and process automation for ophthalmology and haematology practices, developing custom software to streamline clinical and data-management workflows.

teaching.name: Tutoring in Maths, MATLAB & Python
teaching.description: Tutoring and lessons in Mathematics, MATLAB, and Python, supporting students from secondary school through university in building technical and analytical skills.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.subtitle: 20+ Certifications
certifications.description: Six ISTQB certifications spanning test management, automation, performance and GenAI-assisted testing, alongside Agile leadership, performance tooling, and cloud platform credentials across Azure, Oracle Cloud, and Google Cloud.

project0.description: Defining and evolving QA strategy, automation practices, and quality processes to support scalable software delivery, release stability, and continuous improvement across Agile teams. Designing and maintaining scalable, API-first automation frameworks to improve regression coverage, execution efficiency, and overall testing maturity.
project0.impact: Strengthens CI/CD quality gates and test visibility in close collaboration with engineering, product, and DevOps teams, leads risk-based testing and automation scope initiatives, and drives adoption of GenAI-assisted workflows for test design and automation acceleration — while supporting team growth through technical guidance and mentorship.

project1.description: Led performance engineering initiatives for a large insurance platform. Designed workload models and performance strategies aligned with production usage patterns, then executed large-scale load tests using LoadRunner.
project1.impact: Identified system bottlenecks and delivered optimisation recommendations, while developing Python/Selenium scripts to automate performance testing data preparation.

project2.description: QA Engineer Lead across multiple testing squads, ensuring consistent processes and QA best practices in the design and implementation of new APIs and services. Designed and delivered automation accelerators with Python and Selenium, and built automated test scenarios with Robot Framework that improved overall test coverage and system reliability.
project2.impact: Saved around 25 hours of manual work per month for each team, served as Functional Product Owner for a key API, and oversaw quality assurance for new developments with continuous client support on stabilisation and performance.

project3.description: Supported the design of the integration architecture for a new core insurance system, defining and documenting new APIs, orchestration flows, BPMN process models and DMN decision models in Confluence.
project3.impact: Contributed to API testing best practices for consistent, reliable validation across endpoints, and performed manual and exploratory testing with Postman to verify functional scenarios and integration between systems.

project4.description: Defined and implemented a performance testing strategy for a core application at a leading UK insurer, designing a scalable JMeter framework integrated into Azure DevOps pipelines and running up to twice daily with 1,000–7,500 virtual users to simulate real-world load.
project4.impact: Generated actionable performance insights through Grafana dashboards, Excel analysis, and executive presentations, aligning test outcomes with business KPIs to mitigate performance risk and improve scalability.

project5.description: Represents Deloitte at universities and career events, and has established partnerships with top testing tool providers to boost delivery of innovative solutions.
project5.impact: Delivers workshops and training sessions that build performance testing capability across the organisation, and mentors Master's students in software testing and quality assurance research, connecting academic methodologies with industry practice.

research.name: Research
research.description: Research Fellowship in Human-Centered Mobile Robotics at the Institute of Systems and Robotics, University of Coimbra (2019), developing MATLAB algorithms for Brain–Computer Interfaces. Co-authored "A User Identification System based on Code-modulated Visual Evoked Potentials with LED Stimulation", published at IEEE IWBF 2021.

awards.name: Awards
awards.description: Merit Board at the University of Coimbra (2018/2019, 2019/2020) and Merit Award, Top 3% of the University of Coimbra (2016/2017, 2017/2018), recognising academic performance during the Electrical and Computer Engineering degree.

conferences.name: Conferences
conferences.description: Attended Testing Portugal — PSTQB (2022, Porto) and (2026, Lisbon) and g.tec's BCI & Neurotechnology Summer and Spring Schools (2020, online), keeping current with both the QA industry and the neurotechnology research field.

community.name: Community
community.description: Years of volunteer leadership at the University of Coimbra: Students' Representative on the Pedagogical Council, Job & Training Area Coordinator for the Electrical and Computer Engineering Students Board, Robotics Club member, Bot Olympics instructor, and tutor at NExT — Volunteer Tutoring Centre.
